action: As Caschys Blog reports, netbeat will reset all passwords for hosted websites and the customer center and send details in a separate notice; customers should follow that notice.
date_note: Publication day of the Caschys Blog article (22 Nov 2026); the page gives no earlier date for the attack or for netbeat's customer email.
exec: A web host's breach may expose customer and billing data and website access data; hosted sites may be offline.
plain: German web host netbeat told customers that attackers got into parts of its hosting systems. Customer, billing and website login data may be affected, some websites may be offline, and passwords will be reset.

sources.name: Caschys Blog: netbeat: Cyberangriff auf Hosting-Infrastruktur, Passwörter werden zurückgesetzt
Borns IT Blog: Cyberangriff auf Hoster netbeat (22.11.2026)
SecurityLab.ru: Эпидемия взломов хостингов продолжается. Теперь атакован NetBeat

summary: Caschys Blog reports that web host netbeat confirmed a cyberattack on parts of its hosting infrastructure and emailed customers about unauthorised access to its systems. Customer and billing data and access data for hosted websites may be affected; netbeat says misuse cannot currently be ruled out. Affected web servers were taken offline and netbeat plans to reset all hosting and customer-center passwords. It gave no number of affected customers.
title: German web host netbeat confirms cyberattack on hosting infrastructure, plans password reset

validation.note: Caschys Blog and Borns IT Blog (22 Nov) each report netbeat's customer email; SecurityLab.ru (25 Nov) also reports the notice. All relay the customer email; Borns IT Blog says no public netbeat statement appears to exist yet. Location from netbeat Impressum.
